claim.text: In the Lower Kinabatangan Wildlife Sanctuary, Sabah, Thiry et al. combined boat-based feeding observations and fecal trnL metabarcoding to record at least 89 consumed plant taxa belonging to 76 genera and 45 families from multiple groups of proboscis monkeys. The result describes the sampled sanctuary and methods; it is not a complete species-wide diet inventory.
claim.locator: Abstract; Results, “Direct behavioural observations” and combined diet results; Discussion; Conclusion.
claim.scope: Lower Kinabatangan Wildlife Sanctuary, Sabah, Malaysia; direct observations along the Kinabatangan River and 155 fecal samples collected over the study period. The findings are bounded to sampled groups, locations, dates, and method limitations.
claim.lifeStatus: Free-ranging proboscis monkeys in wild riverine forest; the study used no captive or domesticated animals.
